description: Read console output captured since attach: logs, warnings, uncaught exceptions with file, line and stack. Pass cursor=nextCursor from a previous call to get only what is new. Note that Chrome does not replay messages logged before DevCDP attached — reproduce the action or call page_reload to see those.

cursor.description: Return only entries with seq greater than this. 0 for everything held.

include_agent.description: Include DevCDP's own diagnostics, normally hidden so they cannot be mistaken for app errors.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return (most recent first in the buffer order).

name: console_get_logs
